rationale: A valid clean receipt is padded with trailing ASCII spaces (still valid JSON) to exactly 2097153 bytes, one byte over 2 MiB (2097152). The digest is the actual SHA-256 of all padded bytes. The contract bounds all snapshot bytes to 2 MiB, and the clarifications say a bounded read happens before the digest. So the input is invalid: 2/evidence_audit_input_invalid, not snapshot_tampered. One byte over exceeds the bound whether the limit is read as inclusive or exclusive. A mutant without a size check returns 0/evidence_audit_clean. One that reads only 2 MiB and hashes the prefix returns snapshot_tampered.
